edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.object: mutations to genes related to lysosomal function
edges.quote: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL) is a family of neurodegenerative diseases caused by mutations to genes related to lysosomal function.

edges.subject: progranulin
edges.quote: One variant, CNL11, is caused by mutations to the gene encoding the protein progranulin, which regulates neuronal lysosomal function.

edges.subject: AAV92YF-scCAG-PGRN
edges.quote: While mice that receive systemic AAV92YF-scCAG-PGRN at post-natal day 3 or 4 show a reduction in retina thinning, mice injected intravitreally at months 1 and 6 with AAV2.7m8-scCAG-PGRN exhibit no improvement, and mice injected at 12 months of age have thinner retinas than do their controls.

edges.subject: progranulin
edges.quote: Mice heterologously expressing progranulin showed a reduction in lipofuscin deposits and microglia infiltration.
